Subject: Prep: Pineview QBR — account health, renewal risk & exec asks

Team / Emily,

I'm kicking off prep for Pineview's QBR (renewal due mid-April). Attached is the draft health scorecard and our working renewal risk register. High-level ask: I need a 1-paragraph exec-facing summary and up to three "exec attention" items we should surface in the QBR slide deck by EOD 3/3 so Laura can include in her renewal briefing.

Quick context:
- Contract: $1.1M ARR, renewal window opens 2026-04-10.
- Current health score: 72/100 (see attached).
- Primary risks: data residency confirmation, recent latency spikes for embedding API, delays on SSO provisioning noted by Procurement.

Attachments: pineview_q2_health_scorecard.xlsx, pineview_renewal_risk_register.csv

Please reply with: (1) your 1-line exec summary, (2) top 3 risks (with proposed owner + mitigation), (3) any ask for credits, concessions, or product exceptions. I'll consolidate and produce the exec slide.

Thanks — Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Lead, Strategic Accounts

Grace, all —

Thanks for the summary. Two quick notes from renewal side:
- We should be prepared to offer a one-time credit if the latency regression impacted production SLAs in January. Can Marissa confirm whether production traffic saw >1% error/latency impact?
- I'd like a 15-min pre-QBR readout (we'll use this slot to align exec asks). Available windows: 3/4 9:30–9:45 or 3/8 08:30–08:45 PT. Which works for the team?

My suggested exec-facing line: "Pineview shows steady adoption but operational headwinds around latency and SSO provisioning introduce a moderate renewal risk; proposed mitigations include prioritized SRE runbook, temporary credits tied to incident root cause, and a committed remediation timeline."

Adding CS perspective and a short health snapshot (pulled 2026-02-18):
- Adoption: Daily active teams +18% q/q; embeddings volume up 32% month-over-month.
- NPS (product): 7.6 (down from 8.4 last q) — comments tie to latency and occasional API token errors.
- Support: Two sev2 incidents in Jan (SUP-877, SUP-889); SRE has an open action to reduce tail latency.

Top 3 risks and owners: 
1) Latency regression (Owner: Eng/SRE - Vivek) — Mitigation: prioritized runbook + 2-week focused tuning; request: operational post-mortem + commitment on timeline.
2) SSO / provisioning delays (Owner: Account Team - Grace + Sales Ops - Jonas) — Mitigation: offer a named-engineer window to complete config and a checklist for Procurement.
3) Data residency confirmation (Owner: Security/Compliance - Vivek) — Mitigation: provide KMS/HSM architecture doc and SOC2 evidence; Procurement asked for a direct call with Compliance.

I've updated the risk register (attached) with likelihood/impact and suggested recommended severity. See pineview_renewal_risk_register.csv.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success

Quick technical/exec summary to use in the deck: 
- Situation: Production tail-latency spike in late Jan impacted embeddings for batch jobs and a small subset of interactive traffic; engineering identified a mis-sized kernel on the serving stack as root cause.
- Impact: Customer-level health score 72; business impact limited to non-latency-sensitive jobs but visible to product team.
- Ask for execs: Approve a short remediation sprint (2 weeks) + a 10% one-off credit conditional on follow-up RCA acceptance.

Operational notes: I can provide the KMS/HSM and SOC2 artifacts to Procurement by EOD 2/26. I've also opened an internal ticket SUP-1234 for the kernel optimization work; target remediation date 2026-03-05.

Vivek Kulkarni

Folks — thanks for the fast responses. Consolidated decisions and exec asks below (finalizing deck attached: qbr_exec_slide_deck_v3.pptx).

Executive summary (1-line): Pineview is a high-value account showing strong product adoption but facing operational friction (tail latency and SSO provisioning) that elevates renewal risk; proposed mitigation: short remediation sprint, delivery of compliance artifacts, and a conditional one-time credit to preserve momentum.

Top exec attention items (for the QBR slide):
1) Latency remediation + RCA (Owner: Vivek) — Target: remediation by 2026-03-05; ask for exec sign-off on 10% credit conditional on RCA acceptance.
2) Procurement / SSO ramp (Owner: Grace + Jonas) — Ask: named-engineer window and procurement checklist; target: SSO complete by 2026-03-20.
3) Compliance evidence (Owner: Vivek) — Provide KMS/HSM diagram and SOC2 artifacts to Procurement by 2026-02-26 (provided) and confirm data residency statements in writing.

Action owners & next steps:
- Grace: finalize exec slide (today) — DONE (attached).
- Jonas: draft renewal amendment language for the credit (due 3/4).
- Marissa: finalize risk heatmap and add customer quotes to slide (due 3/5).
- Vivek: deliver remediation status and confirm SUP-1234 target (due 3/5).

QBR schedule: customer-facing QBR 2026-03-10 10:00 PT; internal rehearsal 2026-03-09 09:00 PT.

Attachments: qbr_exec_slide_deck_v3.pptx
